title: Python Manager
description:
Job Description Python Manager (Django) Position: Python Manager
 Location: Nagpur, Maharashtra
 Experience: 6-10 Years About the Role We are looking for an experienced Python Manager with strong expertise in Python, Django, and ReactJS to lead a team of developers and drive the successful delivery of web applications. The ideal candidate should possess excellent technical expertise, people management skills, and experience in managing end-to-end software development projects. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor a team of Python developers, ensuring high-quality code and timely project delivery. Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Python and Django . Collaborate with frontend developers to build seamless applications using ReactJS . Review code, enforce coding standards, and ensure best development practices. Plan, assign, and monitor project tasks while ensuring adherence to timelines. Coordinate with cross-functional teams, clients, and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical solutions. Manage project execution using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps , or similar project management platforms. Identify technical risks and provide proactive solutions. Conduct performance reviews, provide technical guidance, and support team development. Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend process improvements. Required Skills & Qualifications 610 years of experience in software development. Strong hands-on experience with Python and Django (mandatory). Working knowledge of ReactJS/Angular (mandatory). Proven experience in leading and managing development teams. Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps , or equivalent. Strong understanding of REST APIs, database design, and software architecture. Knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. Preferred Skills Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Exposure to AI/ML-based applications is an added advantage. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Why Join Us? Opportunity to lead high-impact projects. Work with modern technologies and a collaborative team. Career growth in a technology-driven organization. Exposure to enterprise-scale applications and innovation.

Key Skills: Team handling,Client handling,Python,Angular,React.js,Architectural design,Handling,Architecture
